race_summary.name: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Handicap Hurdle
race_summary.verdict:
SAILING BY is one of the least exposed and shaped as if this increase in trip was worth exploring when third at Fontwell 3 weeks ago. He could be worth siding with from a further reduced mark with his yard continuing in excellent form. Huntingdon scorer Cinnodin might be the danger.

  1. SAILING BY (IRE)
  2. CINNODIN
  3. BETTY'S TIARA

betting_forecast: Sailing By (5/4), Cinnodin (11/4), Betty's Tiara (7/2), Lord Of All Saints (5/1), Robber's Bridge (13/2), One Cool Dreamer (25/1)
